title: FastAPI Request Lifecycle
description: Follow one request from client to route, validation, service, repository, mock database, and response.
learning_objectives: Trace how a client request enters a backend route.
Identify where validation, service logic, repository access, and database interaction fit in the lifecycle.
Explain how a backend response is produced from request data.

lifecycle_nodes.label: Client
lifecycle_nodes.description: The client sends POST /messages with a JSON body.
lifecycle_nodes.beginner_explanation: A browser or app asks the backend to create a message.
lifecycle_nodes.engineer_explanation: Incoming HTTP request: POST /messages with JSON body {"text":"Welcome to OOH-AHH"}.

lifecycle_nodes.label: Route
lifecycle_nodes.beginner_explanation: FastAPI finds the function that belongs to this method and path.
lifecycle_nodes.engineer_explanation: Route matching resolves method POST and path /messages to the create_message handler.

lifecycle_nodes.label: Validation
lifecycle_nodes.description: The request body is shaped into the payload parameter.
lifecycle_nodes.beginner_explanation: The backend checks that the request data can be used by the route.
lifecycle_nodes.engineer_explanation: Validation prepares request body data before business logic receives it.

lifecycle_nodes.label: Service
lifecycle_nodes.description: Service logic decides how the message should be created.
lifecycle_nodes.beginner_explanation: The app decides what should happen with the request.
lifecycle_nodes.engineer_explanation: Service layer placeholder for orchestration between route and data access.

lifecycle_nodes.label: Repository
lifecycle_nodes.description: Repository logic hides how data is saved or fetched.
lifecycle_nodes.beginner_explanation: This layer would ask for stored data or save new data.
lifecycle_nodes.engineer_explanation: Repository layer placeholder for isolating persistence operations.

lifecycle_nodes.label: Mock DB
lifecycle_nodes.description: A mock database returns a deterministic saved message.
lifecycle_nodes.beginner_explanation: A pretend database gives back the saved message.
lifecycle_nodes.engineer_explanation: Mock database placeholder returns a stable record without real persistence.

lifecycle_nodes.label: Response
lifecycle_nodes.description: The saved message is serialized as a JSON response.
lifecycle_nodes.beginner_explanation: The backend sends the created message back to the client.
lifecycle_nodes.engineer_explanation: Response generation serializes the Python dictionary to JSON with status 200.

lifecycle_nodes.label: Error Path
lifecycle_nodes.description: If validation or service logic failed, the lifecycle would branch to an error response.
lifecycle_nodes.beginner_explanation: If the request is not usable, the backend sends an error instead.
lifecycle_nodes.engineer_explanation: Error branch placeholder for future validation and exception responses.

hints: Start with the client and follow each arrow until the response.
The route chooses the function, while the service and repository describe future app boundaries.
Engineer Mode shows the request body, response payload, and metadata placeholders.
